# Tulip Electronics Inc.

> Canadian manufacturer of FANRAM memory boards for legacy Fanuc CNC controls since 1984.
> Kitchener, Ontario, Canada · cnc@tulipmemory.com · 289-389-6117

Tulip Electronics designs and manufactures new (not refurbished) replacement and upgrade
memory boards for legacy Fanuc CNC controls: Fanuc 0 (0A/0B/0C), Fanuc 6, Fanuc 11/12,
Fanuc 15, and Fanuc 16/18. The FANRAM product line was invented by founder Bill Peiman.
Every board carries a 3-year warranty with free lifetime technical support from the
original engineer. Customers still run FANRAM boards shipped in the 1990s.

## Products
- [FANRAM memory boards overview](https://tulipmemory.com/fanuc-memory-upgrades/): all control families, capacities, and OEM cross-references
- [Fanuc 0 memory expansion](https://tulipmemory.com/fanuc-memory-upgrades/fanuc-0/)
- [Fanuc 6 bubble memory replacement](https://tulipmemory.com/fanuc-memory-upgrades/fanuc-6/): 32K, 128K, 512K
- [Fanuc 11 / 12 BMU replacement](https://tulipmemory.com/fanuc-memory-upgrades/fanuc-11-12/): replaces A87L-0001-0084 and A87L-0001-0018; 32K to 2M
- [Fanuc 15 memory upgrade](https://tulipmemory.com/fanuc-memory-upgrades/fanuc-15/): 128K to 2M
- [Fanuc 16 / 18 memory upgrade](https://tulipmemory.com/fanuc-memory-upgrades/fanuc-16-18/): 256K to 2M
- Also: FanFile and FanKit memory solutions; Fanuc 9, 10, 21i-A on request

## Services
- [Services](https://tulipmemory.com/services/): control retrofits, in-person and remote service, technical support, consultation
